editions.text:
Feeder visits totaled 125 for the day, the lowest whole-day count in the eight-day window, against a seven-day average of 212.4 visits. The day recorded 20 species against an average of 22.6, while 377 detections were heard, close to the average of 390.4.

Fifteen species were recorded on all seven prior days and again today, including Tufted Titmouse, Carolina Chickadee, Northern Cardinal, Eastern Towhee, and Blue Jay. Brown Thrasher returned after eight days away, last recorded 2026-10-19, with one probable visit today. Eastern Screech-Owl logged nine confident visits, and Mourning Dove and Canada Goose, both recorded on five of the last seven days, were not recorded today.

The audio source was switched repeatedly on this day, between 07:23 and 08:19 and again between 18:31 and 18:58, moving among pi, pi-mic (movo-dom1), and c120. Detections from those windows came from whichever source was active at the time, so the heard totals reflect the changing microphones and not only the birds present. Feeder visits are not affected by the audio source. No species was recorded for the first time at the station today.
